g.text: Each run is retained separately; row scales match. Durations differ; A/B are cage conditions, not replicates.
01_static: no outer cage. Orientation bins have a source cap of 60. Model counters are asynchronous.
No causal or significance claim. *04_loop_A: reported LiDAR/cage relative displacement.
